verses.verse:
षष्ठांशे चतुर्थेतु भागाः पंच प्रकल्पिताः।
तत्रादौ त्रिसु भागेषु मध्यमौ पंचमः स्मृताः।54।
verses.text: The fourth sixth is divided into five parts; in the first three of these parts are the two Madhyamas and Pa.

commentary.text: And divide the fourth ṣaṣṭhāṃśa (one-sixth) into five parts and place Ma, Ma′ and Pa in the first, second and third parts, in order. Beyond this, by leaving out the [remaining] part, the place of Pa falls of itself at 2/5, as before. For these divisions you can take the help of paper; folding it will make the dividing easy. This method will suit only a length of nine times. If the length is near eight or seven times, then instead of the ṣaṣṭhāṃśa take the saptāṃśa (one-seventh): mark off four saptāṃśas from the bottom, and in those same four saptāṃśas make two, three, four and five divisions in order, and place the 12 notes.
